name: zfmv_stream_fill_audio_buffer
description: zFMV_Stream::FillAudioBuffer refills locked audio buffer spans from an AVI audio stream.
known_limits: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs compiles the source but does not reproduce the original bytes: BN body 293 bytes versus VC object symbol 336 bytes, 36 relocation bytes masked, 12 trailing VC NOPs trimmed, and 267 unmasked mismatches. Review build/vc5-verify/zfmv_stream_fill_audio_buffer/verify/464540_byte_triage.txt before a tier S pass.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja for 0x464540 calls zSndSample::LockBackendBuffers with the requested offset/byte count and returns zero on lock failure, reads nonzero locked spans from AVIStreamRead using readSampleIndex and sample-size derived sample counts, advances readSampleIndex after each span using the first span's sample count for the wrapped second-span advance, reports AVI read failures but still unlocks, and returns zSndSample::UnlockBackendBuffers.

The native smoke patches AVIStreamRead and uses a fake DirectSound buffer to cover lock failure, one-span refill, two-span wrapped refill including the original second-span index advance, AVI read failure continuation to unlock, and unlock failure propagation.
